summary: If 'Use in Controller' is unavailable for an EE in private automation hub with 'No Controllers available', set CONNECTED_ANSIBLE_CONTROLLERS in /etc/pulp/settings.py to the controller node URL, load balancer URL, or a list of controller URLs, then stop and start pulpcore, pulpcore-api, pulpcore-content, pulpcore-worker@1/@2, nginx and redis.
questions: Why do I get 'No Controllers available' in private automation hub?
How do I connect private automation hub to automation controller?
How do I enable 'Use in Controller' for execution environments?

answer_card.title: Fix 'No Controllers available' in private automation hub
answer_card.answer_md:
1. In `/etc/pulp/settings.py` on the hub, add one of:
```python
CONNECTED_ANSIBLE_CONTROLLERS = ['https://my.controller.node']
CONNECTED_ANSIBLE_CONTROLLERS = ['https://my.controller.loadbalancer']
CONNECTED_ANSIBLE_CONTROLLERS = ['https://node1', 'https://node2']
```
2. Restart hub services:
```bash
systemctl stop pulpcore.service pulpcore-api.service pulpcore-content.service pulpcore-worker@1.service pulpcore-worker@2.service nginx.service redis.service
systemctl start pulpcore.service pulpcore-api.service pulpcore-content.service pulpcore-worker@1.service pulpcore-worker@2.service nginx.service redis.service
```
3. Check that **Use in Controller** now works.
